"""F1 signed decoder inlet qualification on existing pairs; requires F1 tool/API."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import numpy as np
from capture import load_capture, sha256
from float_qualification import compare_module_inlet, qualify_inlet
from signed_campaign import select_inputs


def save(path, data, exclusive=True):
    with path.open('x' if exclusive else 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        json.dump(data, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    for arg in ('baseline', 'production-freeze', 'manifest', 'tool', 'engine-source'):
        parser.add_argument('--'+arg, type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--engine-revision', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--module-study', type=Path, required=True, help='F1 signed module study for exact black-witness inlet comparison')
    parser.add_argument('--runtime-dir', action='append', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args(); root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc); stamp = started.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    work = root/'build-patch_raw_bench/float-signed'/stamp; work.mkdir(parents=True)
    baseline = json.loads(args.baseline.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    inputs = select_inputs(baseline)
    module_study = json.loads(args.module_study.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    production = json.loads(args.production_freeze.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    profile = production['profiles']['EOS R6 Mark III']
    if sha256(args.manifest) != production['manifest']['sha256'] or sha256(Path(profile['path'])) != profile['sha256']:
        raise ValueError('Changed profile/calibration')
    tool_hash = sha256(args.tool)
    files = ['tests/raw_bench/float_campaign.py', 'tests/raw_bench/float_qualification.py',
             'tests/raw_bench/capture.py', 'tests/raw_bench/production_capture.cpp', 'tests/raw_bench/signed_campaign.py']
    sources = {p: dict(sha256=sha256(root/p), text=(root/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in files}
    engine_hashes = {str(p.relative_to(args.engine_source)): sha256(p)
                     for p in (args.engine_source/'src').rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.h', '.cpp')}
    if not (args.engine_source/'src/raw/RawDecoder.cpp').is_file() or not engine_hashes:
        raise ValueError('Missing frozen engine source tree')
    freeze = root/'docs/validation/raw'/f'gel-banc-raw-flottant-signe-v001-{stamp}.json'
    save(freeze, dict(schema_version=1, started_at_utc=started.isoformat(), inputs=inputs,
                      parents={str(p.resolve()): sha256(p) for p in (args.baseline, args.production_freeze, args.module_study)},
                      profile=profile, manifest=dict(path=str(args.manifest.resolve()), sha256=sha256(args.manifest)),
                      tool=dict(path=str(args.tool.resolve()), sha256=tool_hash), engine_revision=args.engine_revision,
                      engine_source=str(args.engine_source.resolve()), engine_hashes=engine_hashes, sources=sources,
                      conditions='signedDevelopment requested, WB as-shot, optics off, actual pre-DCP inlet retained; existing six noise pairs, full-frame stats and three256 ROIs. Native decode budget20.8s, 8 RCD workers, OpenCV1/OMP8.',
                      limitations='No nonlinear DCP range modification, no optics/fallback/no-profile inlet coverage, no visual or denoising benefit claim. Negative presence alone does not prove absence of every intermediate quantization.'))
    env = dict(os.environ); env['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = '8'
    env['PATH'] = os.pathsep.join([str(d) for d in args.runtime_dir]+[env.get('PATH', '')])
    empty = work/'empty-profiles'; empty.mkdir(); records = []

    def status(**values):
        save(work/'status.json', dict(started_at_utc=started.isoformat(),
                                      updated_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), **values), False)

    print('FROZEN', freeze, flush=True)
    try:
        for index, pair in enumerate(inputs):
            for shot, item in enumerate(pair['shots']):
                source = Path(item['path'])
                status(status='running', phase='decode', completed=len(records), source=source.name, role=pair['role'])
                out = work/f'{index:02}-{shot}-{source.stem}.json'
                with (work/f'{index:02}-{shot}.log').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as log:
                    subprocess.run([str(args.tool.resolve()), '--input', str(source), '--output', str(out),
                                    '--manifest', str(args.manifest.resolve()), '--profile', profile['path'],
                                    '--profile-root', str(empty), '--capture-camera', '--development', 'signed'],
                                   cwd=root, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True, timeout=240)
                manifest, stages = load_capture(out)
                if (manifest['mode'] != 'signed' or manifest['engine_revision'] != args.engine_revision or
                        manifest['source']['sha256'] != item['sha256'] or manifest['metadata']['iso'] != pair['iso'] or
                        not manifest.get('capabilities', {}).get('signed_development')):
                    raise ValueError('Wrong source/engine/policy/capability')
                inlet = qualify_inlet(out, require_negatives=pair['role'] == 'black')
                matched = [r for r in module_study['records'] if r['iso'] == pair['iso'] and r['role'] == pair['role']]
                if len(matched) != 1:
                    raise ValueError('Module pair missing or ambiguous')
                module = matched[0]['captures']['signed'][shot]
                if sha256(Path(module['path'])) != module['sha256']:
                    raise ValueError('Module capture changed')
                transfer = compare_module_inlet(out, module['path'])
                if pair['role'] == 'black' and transfer['verdict'] != 'pass_exact_module_to_decoder_inlet':
                    raise ValueError('Black witness lacks exact module/inlet comparison')
                if not all(np.isfinite(values).all() for _, values in stages.values()):
                    raise ValueError('Nonfinite camera/master capture')
                budget = manifest['decode_ms'] <= 20800 and manifest['rcd_workers'] <= 8 and manifest['opencv_threads'] <= 1
                records.append(dict(iso=pair['iso'], role=pair['role'], source=item,
                                    capture=dict(path=str(out), sha256=sha256(out)), inlet=inlet, module_to_inlet=transfer,
                                    metadata=manifest['metadata'], decode_ms=manifest['decode_ms'],
                                    peak_bytes=manifest['decode_peak_working_set_bytes'], resource_budget_pass=budget))
                print(len(records), '/12', source.name, 'inlet pass', 'budget', budget, flush=True)
        if sha256(args.tool) != tool_hash or any(sha256(root/p) != v['sha256'] for p, v in sources.items()):
            raise ValueError('Bench sources/tool changed')
        if any(sha256(args.engine_source/p) != digest for p, digest in engine_hashes.items()):
            raise ValueError('Engine sources changed')
        if sha256(args.manifest) != production['manifest']['sha256'] or sha256(Path(profile['path'])) != profile['sha256']:
            raise ValueError('Profile/calibration changed')
        verdict = 'pass_scoped_F1_signed_inlet' if all(r['resource_budget_pass'] for r in records) else 'fail_resource_budget'
        result = root/'docs/validation/raw'/f'banc-raw-flottant-signe-v001-{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}.json'
        save(result, dict(schema_version=1, measured_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                          freeze=dict(path=str(freeze), sha256=sha256(freeze)), records=records, verdict=verdict,
                          limitations='F1 signed inlet only, not A invariance, clean noise truth, visual quality or fully signed DCP processing. Peak memory is measured, not a system80% ceiling proof.'))
        status(status='succeeded' if verdict.startswith('pass') else 'failed', phase='complete', completed=len(records), result=str(result))
        print('RESULT', result, verdict, flush=True)
    except Exception as error:
        save(work/'partial.json', dict(error=str(error), records=records))
        status(status='failed', phase='error', completed=len(records), error=str(error))
        raise


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""F1 pre-DCP signed inlet checks. These do not qualify nonlinear DCP handling."""
import numpy as np
from capture import load_capture


def compare_module_inlet(decoder_capture, module_capture):
    decoder, ds = load_capture(decoder_capture); module, ms = load_capture(module_capture)
    if (decoder['source']['sha256'] != module['source']['sha256'] or
            decoder['engine_revision'] != module['engine_revision'] or
            decoder['mode'] != 'signed' or module['mode'] != 'signed'):
        raise ValueError('Module/decoder source, revision or policy mismatch')
    if module['metadata']['orientation_flip'] != 0:
        return dict(verdict='not_compared_rotated_sparse_ROIs', reason='Sensor/display ROIs are different locations after rotation; no fabricated comparison')
    dk = {origin for stage, origin in ds if stage == 'pre_dcp_camera_rgb'}
    mk = {origin for stage, origin in ms if stage == 'pre_output_camera_rgb'}
    if len(dk) != 3 or dk != mk:
        raise ValueError('Module/decoder inlet ROI geometry mismatch')
    rows = []
    for origin in sorted(dk):
        dd, actual = ds[('pre_dcp_camera_rgb', origin)]
        md, expected = ms[('pre_output_camera_rgb', origin)]
        if any(dd[k] != md[k] for k in ('shape', 'dtype', 'unit', 'layout')):
            raise ValueError('Module/decoder domain mismatch')
        if (not np.isfinite(actual).all() or not np.isfinite(expected).all() or
                actual.tobytes() != expected.tobytes()):
            raise ValueError('Signed module output changed before DCP inlet')
        rows.append(dict(origin_yx=list(origin), bitwise_equal=True, values=int(actual.size)))
    return dict(verdict='pass_exact_module_to_decoder_inlet', orientation_flip=0, rois=rows)


def qualify_inlet(path, require_negatives=False):
    manifest, stages = load_capture(path)
    summary = manifest.get('full_camera')
    if not summary or summary.get('dtype') != 'f32' or summary.get('finite') is not True:
        raise ValueError('Missing finite float32 camera inlet evidence')
    shape = summary.get('shape', [])
    if len(shape) != 3 or shape[-1] != 3 or any(type(v) != int or v <= 0 for v in shape):
        raise ValueError('Invalid inlet geometry')
    if summary.get('unit') != 'linear_camera_white_1' or summary.get('orientation') != 'display':
        raise ValueError('Wrong camera inlet domain')
    negatives = np.asarray(summary.get('negative_fraction'), dtype=float)
    minima = np.asarray(summary.get('minimum'), dtype=float)
    if negatives.shape != (3,) or minima.shape != (3,) or not np.isfinite([negatives, minima]).all():
        raise ValueError('Incomplete inlet statistics')
    if np.any(negatives < 0) or np.any(negatives > 1) or np.any((negatives > 0) != (minima < 0)):
        raise ValueError('Inconsistent signed inlet statistics')
    roi = [(key, desc, values) for key, (desc, values) in stages.items() if key[0] == 'pre_dcp_camera_rgb']
    if len(roi) != 3:
        raise ValueError('Expected three observed inlet ROIs')
    rows = []
    for key, desc, values in roi:
        if (desc['dtype'] != 'f32' or desc['layout'] != 'rgb' or values.shape[-1] != 3 or
                desc['unit'] != summary['unit'] or desc['orientation'] != summary['orientation'] or
                not np.isfinite(values).all()):
            raise ValueError('Invalid inlet ROI contract')
        rows.append(dict(origin_yx=list(key[1]), minimum=values.min(axis=(0, 1)).tolist(),
                         negative_fraction=np.mean(values < 0, axis=(0, 1)).tolist()))
    # Negative presence is required only on black witnesses, never on every
    # normally illuminated photo. Lack of negatives is not a generic failure.
    if require_negatives and (not np.all(negatives > 0) or
                              not all(all(v < 0 for v in row['minimum']) for row in rows)):
        raise ValueError('Signed black witness lost negative values at DCP inlet')
    return dict(verdict='pass_scoped_float_inlet', source=manifest['source'],
                engine_revision=manifest['engine_revision'], full_camera=summary, rois=rows,
                negative_witness_required=require_negatives,
                limitations='Observed DCP inlet only; no proof of fully signed DCP tables/curves, CFA/no-profile inlet or absence of intermediate quantization from negative presence alone.')

"""X4 A/B pilot on frozen historical pairs; no fitted coefficients or TIFFs."""
import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

from capture import compare_captures, load_capture, sha256
from signed_measurement import measure_pair


def save(path, value, exclusive=True):
    with path.open('x' if exclusive else 'w', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
        json.dump(value, handle, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False)


def select_inputs(baseline):
    expected = {(iso, role) for iso in (1600, 51200)
                for role in ('black', 'near_black_scene', 'illuminated_scene')}
    selected = [r for r in baseline['records'] if (r['iso'], r['role']) in expected]
    if len(selected) != 6 or {(r['iso'], r['role']) for r in selected} != expected:
        raise ValueError('Need exactly the six previously measured pairs')
    inputs = []
    for pair in selected:
        if len(pair['paths']) != 2 or len(set(pair['paths'])) != 2:
            raise ValueError('Invalid pair')
        shots = []
        for name in pair['paths']:
            source = Path(name); historical_record = baseline['native'][name]['record']
            if sha256(source) != historical_record['source_sha256']:
                raise ValueError('Missing/changed historical source: ' + name)
            shots.append(dict(path=str(source), sha256=historical_record['source_sha256'],
                              black=historical_record['applied_black_dn'], white=historical_record['white_before_process']))
        inputs.append(dict(iso=pair['iso'], role=pair['role'], shots=shots))
    return inputs


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--baseline', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--tool', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--engine-source', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--engine-revision', required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--previous-study', type=Path, help='Previous immutable X4, exact A check on shared boundaries')
    parser.add_argument('--runtime-dir', type=Path, action='append', required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc); stamp = started.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
    work = root/'build-patch_raw_bench/signed'/stamp
    work.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    tool = args.tool.resolve()
    baseline_hash = sha256(args.baseline)
    baseline = json.loads(args.baseline.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    previous_hash = sha256(args.previous_study) if args.previous_study else None
    previous = json.loads(args.previous_study.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if args.previous_study else None
    inputs = select_inputs(baseline)
    revision = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
    files = ['tests/raw_bench/signed_campaign.py', 'tests/raw_bench/signed_measurement.py',
             'tests/raw_bench/development_capture.cpp', 'tests/raw_bench/capture.py']
    sources = {p: dict(sha256=sha256(root/p), text=(root/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in files}
    engine_files = ['src/raw/RawInput.cpp', 'src/raw/RawInput.h', 'src/raw/LibRawInput.cpp', 'src/raw/LibRawInput.h', 'src/raw/RawDevelopment.cpp',
                    'src/raw/RawDevelopment.h', 'src/raw/Demosaic.cpp', 'src/raw/Demosaic.h']
    engine_sources = {p: dict(sha256=sha256(args.engine_source/p), text=(args.engine_source/p).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
                      for p in engine_files}
    tool_hash = sha256(tool)
    freeze = root/'docs/validation/raw'/f'gel-banc-raw-signe-v001-{stamp}.json'
    save(freeze, dict(schema_version=1, started_at_utc=started.isoformat(), inputs=inputs,
                      baseline=dict(path=str(args.baseline.resolve()), sha256=baseline_hash),
                      bench_revision=revision, engine_revision=args.engine_revision,
                      previous_study=dict(path=str(args.previous_study.resolve()), sha256=previous_hash) if previous else None,
                      engine_source=str(args.engine_source.resolve()), engine_sources=engine_sources,
                      tool=dict(path=str(tool), sha256=tool_hash), sources=sources,
                      conditions='As-shot gains, sensor orientation, three fixed256 ROIs, explicit previously applied black/white per frame; no DCP, optics or denoising; no coefficient fitted.',
                      policy_scope='F1: signed CFA through RCD and median, unbounded signed float output. PreOutputCameraRgb equals the signed output. A uses the reciprocal product grid historically delivered to DCP. Production default remains A.',
                      interpretation='Mean of black frames relative to applied black is a bias proxy, not independently measured ideal zero. Pair variance excludes common fixed pattern/scene; movement/drift not corrected. CFA phases distinct. No clean-reference or visual-success verdict.'))
    env = dict(os.environ); env['OMP_NUM_THREADS'] = '8'
    env['PATH'] = os.pathsep.join([str(d) for d in args.runtime_dir] + [env.get('PATH', '')])
    rows = []

    def status(**values):
        save(work/'status.json', dict(started_at_utc=started.isoformat(), updated_at_utc=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), **values), False)

    print('FROZEN', freeze, flush=True)
    try:
        for index, pair in enumerate(inputs):
            captures = {'parity': [], 'signed': []}; provenance = {'parity': [], 'signed': []}
            for shot, item in enumerate(pair['shots']):
                for mode in ('parity', 'signed'):
                    status(status='running', phase='capture', completed_pairs=len(rows),
                           iso=pair['iso'], role=pair['role'], shot=shot, mode=mode)
                    if sha256(Path(item['path'])) != item['sha256']:
                        raise ValueError('Source changed before capture')
                    out = work/f'{index:02}-{shot}-{mode}.json'
                    command = [str(tool), '--input', item['path'], '--output', str(out),
                               '--path', 'candidate', '--mode', mode, '--black',
                               ','.join(str(v) for v in item['black']), '--white', str(item['white'])]
                    with (work/f'{index:02}-{shot}-{mode}.log').open('x', encoding='utf-8') as log:
                        subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                       check=True, timeout=240)
                    capture = load_capture(out); manifest = capture[0]
                    if manifest['source']['sha256'] != item['sha256'] or manifest['metadata']['iso'] != pair['iso']:
                        raise ValueError('Capture source/ISO mismatch')
                    if manifest['engine_revision'] != args.engine_revision:
                        raise ValueError('Capture engine revision mismatch')
                    captures[mode].append(capture)
                    provenance[mode].append(dict(path=str(out), sha256=sha256(out), applied=manifest['applied']))
                for key in ('black', 'white', 'divisor', 'gains'):
                    if captures['parity'][shot][0]['applied'][key] != captures['signed'][shot][0]['applied'][key]:
                        raise ValueError('A/B development parameters differ: ' + key)
            invariance = []
            if previous:
                matching = [r for r in previous['records'] if r['iso'] == pair['iso'] and r['role'] == pair['role']]
                if len(matching) != 1:
                    raise ValueError('Previous study pair missing/ambiguous')
                for shot in range(2):
                    old = matching[0]['captures']['parity'][shot]
                    if sha256(Path(old['path'])) != old['sha256']:
                        raise ValueError('Previous A capture changed')
                    # Raw input and pre-output processing remain exact; F1 A
                    # intentionally changed final float representation to the
                    # product historically received by DCP, not division.
                    common = ('unpacked_cfa', 'black_subtracted_cfa', 'normalized_cfa',
                              'pre_demosaic_cfa', 'post_demosaic_camera_rgb',
                              'pre_output_camera_rgb')
                    check = compare_captures(old['path'], provenance['parity'][shot]['path'], common)
                    if check['verdict'] != 'pass':
                        raise ValueError('A changed against previous C4')
                    invariance.append(check)
            result = measure_pair(captures)
            rows.append(dict(iso=pair['iso'], role=pair['role'], inputs=pair['shots'],
                             captures=provenance, previous_A_invariance=invariance, measurements=result))
            print(len(rows), '/6', pair['iso'], pair['role'], 'measured', flush=True)
        if sha256(tool) != tool_hash or sha256(args.baseline) != baseline_hash:
            raise ValueError('Tool or baseline changed during campaign')
        if previous and sha256(args.previous_study) != previous_hash:
            raise ValueError('Previous study changed during campaign')
        if any(sha256(root/p) != info['sha256'] for p, info in sources.items()):
            raise ValueError('Study sources changed during campaign')
        if any(sha256(args.engine_source/p) != info['sha256'] for p, info in engine_sources.items()):
            raise ValueError('Engine sources changed during campaign')
        finished = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        out = root/'docs/validation/raw'/f'banc-raw-signe-v001-{finished.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")}.json'
        save(out, dict(schema_version=1, campaign_id='raw-signed-'+stamp,
                       started_at_utc=started.isoformat(), measured_at_utc=finished.isoformat(),
                       completed_at_utc=finished.isoformat(), freeze=dict(path=str(freeze), sha256=sha256(freeze)),
                       records=rows, verdict='measured_not_validated',
                       limitations='Small exploratory corpus, no reserved frames opened, no DCP/raster output or visual success claim; internal lower bounds documented in freeze. Variance is not a denoising quality score; less variance can mean clipping. No claim of recovery of all information or optimal black levels.'))
        status(status='succeeded', phase='complete', completed_pairs=len(rows), result=str(out))
        print('RESULT', out, flush=True)
    except Exception as error:
        save(work/'partial.json', dict(error=str(error), records=rows))
        status(status='failed', phase='error', completed_pairs=len(rows), error=str(error))
        raise


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
